# Medical Kemei

> > ISO 13485 and CE certified medical consumables manufacturer specializing in disposable gloves, surgical gowns, wound care products, and medical supplies since 1999.

Jiangxi Kemei Medical Apparatus & Instruments Group Co., Ltd. is a China-based manufacturer offering wholesale medical supplies with FDA, CE, SGS, and TUV certifications. The company provides OEM services and comprehensive product lines including PPE, cotton and plastic medical products, and electronic monitoring devices.

## Key Topics

- ISO 13485:2016 certification
- CE and FDA compliance
- Disposable medical gloves (nitrile, latex, surgical)
- Infection control and PPE
- Non-woven fabric products
- Surgical gowns and face masks
- Wound dressing and gauze products
- Medical adhesive tapes
- OEM and wholesale manufacturing
- ASTM and SGS testing standards
- Healthcare safety equipment
- Jiangxi Kemei Medical Group
- Cleanroom manufacturing
